changes.crop_horizontal_centering: Re-measured the soil texture x-axis positions using the same connected-component method as the earlier y-axis fix -- result was within 0.2-0.3% of existing values, no coordinate error found. Since the pixel measurement doesn't show an error, the reported left-shift is most likely the sprout/leaf emoji glyphs' own visual weight sitting slightly left-of-center within their character box. Applied a +1.3 world-% rightward nudge to all farm plot x-coordinates as a corrective offset in the reported direction (not a re-derived measurement, since the measurement itself showed no error).
changes.crop_size: Reduced an additional 30% on top of the prior 3% reduction.
changes.pet_movement: Replaced constant-speed straight-line walking with ease-in-out acceleration/deceleration plus a gentle curved path between waypoints, and randomized walk speed and pause duration each cycle.
changes.shop_popup_alignment: Root cause: .farm-grid .item already had the flex-column + bottom-anchored-button CSS needed to keep buttons aligned regardless of description length, but .shop-grid .item (the upgrade cards) never had it. Extended the same rule to shop-grid.
changes.farm_tool_expansion: Added two new upgrades: 성장촉진 비료 (additional 10% growth-time reduction, stacks with water) and 행운의 네잎클로버 (15% chance of double harvest reward).
changes.hamburger_map_preview: Root cause: the drawer's map preview pointed at a completely different, older static image instead of the actual live game background, so it never reflected any map changes across many versions. Repointed it to the real background image.
changes.institution_patrol_mechanic: New threat/patrol minigame: institutions get periodically infiltrated by a themed threat (thief, hacker, or voice-phishing scammer depending on the institution), shown with a pulsing red ring and icon plus a notification. Interacting brings up a patrol button that resolves the threat for a 200-500G bonus; leaving it unresolved for 45 seconds applies a 5% gold penalty instead. Checked every 15 seconds with a 30% spawn chance, one threat active at a time for this first version.

verification.syntax: node --check passes on game.js and game-systems.js.
verification.patrol_flow_tested: Injected an active threat via localStorage, walked to the institution, confirmed the patrol UI and that resolving it granted a bonus and cleared the threat.
verification.penalty_flow_tested: Injected a threat set to expire in 1 second and confirmed the exact expected 5% gold penalty applied automatically.
verification.new_upgrades_tested: Confirmed both new upgrade cards render and purchasing persists correctly.
verification.existing_regression_suite_rerun: JS syntax check, road-graph integrity, the stuck-at-node escape test, the speed-equalization test, and the standard headless-browser playthrough all still pass.
